shared_elements: possible boat-like curved hull line with vertical strokes above it
isolated single motif on an otherwise plain field
justification: Both surfaces carry a single, sparse schematic outline-drawn motif built from simple lines, and the faint figure in B has a curved lower line with short strokes rising from it that could be read as a boat with crew, loosely echoing the hull-and-mast ship in A. But A shows a fully explicit and elaborate composition — a ship with mast, yard, upturned stems, framed by an arch and set above a band of stylised waves — whereas B shows only a small, ambiguous, unframed figure with no accompanying wave band, arch or comparable internal detail.
